items: 3 cups crushed pretzels (crushing in a bag is easiest)

steps.title: Mix the base
steps.body: Mix **3 cups crushed pretzels**, **⅓-½ cup chopped pecans**, **2 Tbsp sugar** and **¾ cup butter, softened/melted**, then press into bottom of ungreased 9×13 pan (can mix in pan).

steps.title: Bake the base
steps.body: Bake at 350°F for 10 minutes or until lightly brown.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.body: Beat **8 oz package cream cheese** and **¾ cup sugar**, then fold in **8 oz tub whipped topping**.

steps.title: Spread the filling
steps.body: Spread over the cooled crust, ensuring no holes for jello to sleep down to the crust.

steps.title: Make the topping
steps.body: Dissolve **6 oz raspberry Jell-O mix** in **2 cups boiling water**. Stir in **20 oz frozen raspberries** until almost set.

steps.title: Chill
steps.body: Spread Jell-O over filling and refrigerate overnight.
